```{r unify tissue proteomic datasets}

## colnames
Rename_ordered <- Rename[match(colnames(proteome_dataset), Rename$Sample_ID), ]
muscle_proteome <- proteome_dataset
matched_indices <- match(colnames(muscle_proteome), Rename_ordered$Sample_ID)
colnames(muscle_proteome)[!is.na(matched_indices)] <- Rename_ordered$Group_Time_Cond_Participant[matched_indices[!is.na(matched_indices)]]

Info_ordered <- Info[match(colnames(phospho_dataset), Info$label), ]
muscle_phospho <- phospho_dataset
matched_indices <- match(colnames(muscle_phospho), Info_ordered$label)
colnames(muscle_phospho)[!is.na(matched_indices)] <- Info_ordered$Group_Time_Cond_Participant[matched_indices[!is.na(matched_indices)]]

# for MOFA
muscle_proteome_forMOFA <- muscle_proteome
phospho_forMOFA <- muscle_phospho

```


```{r MDS clinical data}

############################### FIGURE 5A ####################################
## load meta data
rownames(meta_forMOFA) <- meta_forMOFA$Group_Time_Cond_Participant

clin_var <- c("Age", "BMI", "FFM", "FM", "VO2max_kg", "Mvalue", "HbA1c", "TG")

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(meta_forMOFA), 
                           intersect(colnames(muscle_proteome_forMOFA), 
                                     intersect(colnames(WAT_proteome_forMOFA), 
                                               colnames(plasma_forMOFA))))

meta_forMOFA <- meta_forMOFA[common_samples, ]
rownames(meta_forMOFA) <- meta_forMOFA$Group_Time_Cond_Participant

# Clinical data scaling and MDS
clin_mds <- meta_forMOFA %>% dplyr::select(any_of(clin_var))
rownames(clin_mds) <- rownames(meta_forMOFA)
clin_scale <- scale(clin_mds)

# MDS calculation
dist_clin <- dist(clin_scale)
mds_clin <- as.data.frame(cmdscale(dist_clin, k = 2))
colnames(mds_clin) <- c("Dim1", "Dim2")
mds_clin <- cbind(mds_clin, clin_scale)

# Correlation with MDS dimensions
cor_df_clin <- clin_scale %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    Dim1 = ~ cor(.x, mds_clin$Dim1, method = "pearson"),
    Dim2 = ~ cor(.x, mds_clin$Dim2, method = "pearson")
  ))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "key", values_to = "value") %>%
  separate(key, into = c("Variable", "Dim"), sep = "_Dim") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Dim, values_from = value)

cor_df_clin <- cor_df_clin %>%
  dplyr::rename(Dim1 = `1`, Dim2 = `2`) %>%
  mutate(Dim1 = as.numeric(Dim1), Dim2 = as.numeric(Dim2))

scaling_factor <- 2  
cor_df_clin <- cor_df_clin %>%
  mutate(Dim1 = Dim1 * scaling_factor, Dim2 = Dim2 * scaling_factor)

meta_forMOFA$Group_Time <- paste(meta_forMOFA$Group, meta_forMOFA$TimeCond, sep="_")

mds_clin$Group_Time <- meta_forMOFA$Group_Time[match(rownames(mds_clin), meta_forMOFA$Group_Time_Cond_Participant)]
mds_clin$Participant <- meta_forMOFA$Participant[match(rownames(mds_clin), meta_forMOFA$Group_Time_Cond_Participant)]

mds_clin <- mds_clin %>% arrange(Participant, Group_Time)

plot_mds_clin <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = mds_clin, 
            aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2, group = Participant, color = Group_Time), 
            size = 0.5, alpha = 0.2) + 
  geom_point(data = mds_clin, 
             aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2, color = Group_Time), 
             size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +   
  geom_segment(data = cor_df_clin,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = Dim1, yend = Dim2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), 
               color = "black", alpha = 1) +  
  geom_text(data = cor_df_clin, 
            aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2, label = Variable),
            size = 2, vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, 
            color = "black", fontface="bold", alpha = 1) + 
  labs(title = "MDS plot of Clinical Variables",
       x = "Dimension 1",
       y = "Dimension 2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T2D_PreBasal" = "violet", 
                                "T2D_PostBasal" = "magenta4",
                                "Obese_PreBasal" = "mediumpurple1",
                                "Obese_PostBasal" = "purple4",
                                "Lean_PreBasal" = "skyblue1",
                                "Lean_PostBasal" = "deepskyblue4")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", alpha = 0.5)

print(plot_mds_clin)


```


```{r MOFA2}


MOFAdatasets <- list(
  muscle_proteome_forMOFA,
  WAT_proteome_forMOFA,
  plasma_forMOFA,
  phospho_forMOFA
)

common_columns <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(MOFAdatasets, colnames))
# 81 columns (just basal samples, pre and post HIIT)

muscle_ordered <- muscle_proteome_forMOFA[, common_columns, drop = FALSE]
WAT_ordered <- WAT_proteome_forMOFA[, common_columns, drop = FALSE]
plasma_ordered <- plasma_forMOFA[, common_columns, drop = FALSE]
phospho_ordered <- phospho_forMOFA[, common_columns, drop = FALSE]


data_list <- list(
    Muscle = as.matrix(muscle_ordered),
    Phospho = as.matrix(phospho_ordered),
    WAT = as.matrix(WAT_ordered),
    Plasma = as.matrix(plasma_ordered)
)


mofa_object <- create_mofa(data_list)


# default model options
model_opts <- get_default_model_options(mofa_object)

# Set training options
train_opts <- get_default_training_options(mofa_object)
train_opts$maxiter <- 1000

# default data options
data_opts <- get_default_data_options(mofa_object)
data_opts$scale_views <- TRUE  

mofa_object <- prepare_mofa(
  object = mofa_object,
  model_options = model_opts,
  training_options = train_opts,
  data_options = data_opts
)

set.seed(123)

# Run MOFA
trained_mofa <- run_mofa(mofa_object, use_basilisk = TRUE)


## add metadata
# extract sample names from MOFA object
mofa_samples <- samples_metadata(trained_mofa)$sample
# metadata frame
meta_df <- data.frame(sample = mofa_samples)
# make sure Sample_ID in meta is character
sample_metadata <- Rename[Rename$Group_Time_Cond_Participant %in% common_columns, ]
# 81
# join MOFA sample names with Rename_basal
meta_df_joined <- left_join(meta_df, sample_metadata, by = c("sample" = "Group_Time_Cond_Participant"))
#  add clinical and metadata
meta_df_joined <- left_join(meta_df_joined, meta_forMOFA, by = c("sample" = "Group_Time_Cond_Participant"))
# rownames to match sample names (required for MOFA)
rownames(meta_df_joined) <- meta_df_joined$sample
# assign metadata to MOFA object
samples_metadata(trained_mofa) <- meta_df_joined




# Save the trained MOFA model and reload the same model next times
#saveRDS(trained_mofa, file = here::here("data/trained_mofa_model.rds"))
trained_mofa <- readRDS(here::here("data/trained_mofa_model.rds"))






############################## FIGURE 5C ##############################################

p <- plot_variance_explained(trained_mofa, x = "view", y = "factor", transpose = TRUE) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +  
  labs(x = "Omics Layer", y = "MOFA Factor")
print(p)




################################# FIGURE 5F ###################################
trainingplot <- plot_factors(trained_mofa, 
             factors = 6:8,       
             color_by = "Timepoint",    
             dot_size = 1)

############################## FIGURE S5B #####################################
all_training <- plot_factors(trained_mofa, 
             factors = 1:10,         
             color_by = "Timepoint",    
             dot_size = 1)

################################ FIGURE 5E #################################
groupplot <-plot_factors(trained_mofa, 
             factors = c(2,4,5,10),        
             color_by = "Group.x",    
             dot_size = 1)

################################ FIGURE S5A ##################################
all_group <- plot_factors(trained_mofa, 
             factors = 1:10,        
             color_by = "Group.x",     
             dot_size = 1)


############################ FIGURE 5D ########################################
clincor<-correlate_factors_with_covariates(trained_mofa, covariates = c("Mvalue", 
                                                               "VO2max_kg",
                                                               "Age",
                                                               "FM",
                                                               "FFM", 
                                                               "BMI",
                                                               "TG1",
                                                               "HbA1c"
                                                              ),
                                  factors = 1:10)




################################ FIGURE 5G #######################################
p1<- plot_weights(trained_mofa, view = "Muscle", factor = 7, nfeatures = 10)






# Extract weights 
weights_list <- get_weights(
  trained_mofa,
  views = "WAT",
  factors = 10,
  abs = FALSE,
  scale = FALSE,
  as.data.frame = FALSE
)

weights_vec <- weights_list[[1]]  
top_weights <- tibble(
  Feature = names(weights_vec),
  Weight = weights_vec
) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Weight))) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  slice(1:20)



# Get weights for all views and all factors
all_weights <- get_weights(trained_mofa, as.data.frame = TRUE)
#  Filter to only the first 10 factors
all_weights_filtered <- all_weights %>%
  filter(factor %in% paste0("Factor", 1:10))

# Add rank per (view, factor) based on absolute weight
all_weights_ranked <- all_weights_filtered %>%
  group_by(view, factor) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(value))) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
```
